app.name: NIS2 Compass
app.description: Classify your entity, build the required documentation and audit your network — guided end to end.

landing.title: Know your NIS2 obligations. Then meet them.
landing.subtitle: NIS2 Compass helps you determine whether the directive applies, assemble the required documentation, and audit your IT environment — with Romanian and English guidance from day one.

audit.title: Security audit
audit.description: Map your network, assess every device, track findings and export an audit report that maps back to NIS2 requirements.

reasons.cerCritical: The entity is a critical entity under the CER Directive, so NIS2 applies regardless of size.
reasons.domainRegistration: Domain name registration services are covered regardless of size; they do not meet the essential-entity criteria, so they default to important.
reasons.qualifiedTrust: Qualified trust service providers are essential regardless of size.
reasons.tldRegistry: Top-level domain registries are essential regardless of size.
reasons.dnsProvider: DNS service providers are essential regardless of size.
reasons.centralPublicAdministration: Central government public administration entities are essential regardless of size.
reasons.publicElectronicCommunications: Public electronic communications providers at or above the medium size threshold are essential.
reasons.identifiedEssential: The Member State has identified this entity as essential.
reasons.annexILarge: The entity operates in an Annex I sector and exceeds the medium-sized ceilings, so it is essential.
reasons.annexIMedium: The entity operates in an Annex I sector and does not qualify as essential, so it is important.
reasons.annexIIMediumPlus: The entity operates in an Annex II sector and qualifies as medium-sized or larger, so it is important.
reasons.publicElectronicCommunicationsSmall: Public electronic communications providers are covered regardless of size; below the essential threshold they are important.
reasons.trustServiceProvider: Trust service providers are covered regardless of size; without the qualified status they are important.
reasons.regionalPublicAdministration: Regional public administration may be designated by the Member State following a risk assessment. Confirm with DNSC.
reasons.localPublicAdministration: Local public administration is optional for Member States. Confirm with DNSC whether Romania applies the directive to your entity.
reasons.notListedSector: The selected sector is not listed in Annex I or Annex II, so the directive does not apply based on these answers.
reasons.sizeIndependentAmbiguous: A size-independent criterion may bring the entity into scope. The final designation depends on the Member State, so confirm with DNSC or a lawyer.
reasons.listedSectorSmall: The sector is listed, but the consolidated size is micro or small and no size-independent criterion applies.
reasons.insufficientInformation: The answers do not determine the outcome. Confirm the details with the authority.
reasons.stored: This result was stored from an earlier classification run.

wizard.title: Classification wizard
wizard.subtitle: Four short steps: entity, size, size-independent criteria and review.
wizard.validation: Complete the required fields before continuing.
wizard.submitError: The classification could not be completed. Check the inputs and try again.
wizard.countryHelp: Select every EU member state where the entity provides services or carries out activities.
wizard.sectorHelp: Choose the Annex I or Annex II sector. If your sector is not listed, choose the last option.
wizard.notListed: My sector is not listed in Annex I or II
wizard.notListedHelp: Sectors outside the annexes, such as education, are generally out of scope. You can still use the documents as voluntary good practice.
wizard.sizeHelp: Use the figures for the last closed financial year. The EU SME ceilings are applied automatically.
wizard.consolidationHelp: Use partner or linked enterprises when Recommendation 2003/361/EC requires consolidation.
wizard.partnersHelp: Add enterprises where you hold between 25% and 50%. Their data is added in proportion to your ownership.
wizard.linkedHelp: Add enterprises where you hold more than 50% or control them directly or indirectly. Their data is added at 100%.
wizard.name: Name (optional)
wizard.criteriaHelp: These rules can bring an entity into scope regardless of size. Select only what applies.
wizard.rolePublicComms: Public electronic communications network or service provider
wizard.roleTrust: Trust service provider without qualified status
wizard.designationHelp: These facts may bring the entity into scope regardless of size, but the final designation is made by the Member State.
wizard.designationIdentifiedEssential: Already identified as essential by the Member State
wizard.designationSole: Sole provider of a service essential for critical societal or economic activities
wizard.designationImpact: Disruption could significantly affect public safety, security or health
wizard.designationSystemic: Disruption could create significant systemic or cross-border risk
wizard.designationNational: Critical because of specific national or regional importance
wizard.reviewHelp: Running the classification stores a new versioned result and updates your document checklist. You can re-run it whenever the company data changes.
